leo.release: Requesting quiet-slot claim for schema migration 'user_events_shard_split'. Planned change window 02:20-02:50 UTC. DeployBot, please reserve slot and pin migration commit.
deploybot: Slot claimed: slot-487. Window 1748213344-1748215144 (02:20-02:50 UTC). Pinned deploy tag: rwd-mig/user_events@v3.2. Command to start: `deploybot run --slot slot-487 --quiet-mode --pin rwd-mig/user_events@v3.2`
ana.db: ACK. I'll disable async consumers and put a short freeze on writes to topic user_events 5m before start. ETA to quiesce: 6m.
carla.sre: Thumbs on on-call for lock watch. Rollback trigger: >5s median lock wait or >1% 500s on API. If triggered, abort and rollback to rwd-mig/user_events@v3.1
sam.ops: Backfill plan: chunk size 20k rows, throttle 200 qps, track progress to /ops/metrics/user_events_backfill.
leo.release: We'll run preflight: `pg_clone --dry-run --slot slot-487` at 02:10 UTC. Ana, can you verify FK checks are deferred?
ana.db: Yes, FK validation deferred. We'll run quick checksum on sample shards after first 3 chunks.
deploybot: Run started by leo.release at 1748213380. Staging hooks passed. Note: lock escalation policy ON, fallback to read-only for 60s before abort.
carla.sre: Watching replication lag and row-level lock stats. Set alert: replication_lag > 30s -> abort.
ana.db: First chunk applied. partial backfill: 19.8k rows. No lock spikes.
leo.release: Good. Keep logs here: https://logs.redwood/slot-487
sam.ops: If we need to abort, recommend these steps: 1) `deploybot cancel --slot slot-487` 2) `db-rollback --tag rwd-mig/user_events@v3.1` 3) unpause consumers. I'll prepare runbook snippet.
carla.sre: Noted. If abort occurs, coordinate with on-call to release slot to avoid double-claim. :thumbsup: 
deploybot: Slot complete at 1748213389. Status: success. Backfill 200k rows applied total. Migration rolled forward to v3.2. Post-checks passing.
leo.release: Thanks team. Follow-up: open release note PR with migration tag and post-mortem if any variance >1%.
